en.topic_title: China-funded Confucius Institutes deemed US national security threat: Hegseth
en.topic_summary:
The US Department of Defense has designated Confucius Institutes, Chinese-funded cultural centers on American university campuses, a threat to US national security, Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth said Friday.



Confucius Institute at Troy University. Photo: Wikicommons.



Washington considers the centers to be propaganda tools of the Chinese Communist Party, and has taken steps to shut them down.
